title: Design, synthesis, and anticancer evaluation of N4-substituted thiosemicarbazones derived from ortho- and para-ethoxy-benzaldehydes.
authors: Singh, Vipin; Haribabu, Jebiti; Arulraj, Arunachalam; Vediyappan, Ramesh; Sreekanth, Anandaram
journal: Spectrochimica acta. Part A, Molecular and biomolecular spectroscopy
one_liner_zh: 该文为抗癌缩氨基硫脲衍生物的合成与表征，虽含CT-DNA结合光谱实验和EGFR蛋白对接，但核心是药物化学与抗癌活性，非蛋白质-DNA互作机制或TF-DNA结合建模，方法上无AI/物理模拟创新。
abstract: R(2) - C(S) - NH - N = CH - R(1) [R(1) = o-OCH(2)CH(3) & R(2) = C(4)H(9)N (2-EBP), R(1) = o-OCH(2)CH(3) & R(2) = C(4)H(9)NO (2-EBM), R(1) = p-OCH(2)CH(3) & R(2) = C(4)H(9)N (4-EBP), and R(1) = p-OCH(2)CH(3) & R(2) = C(4)H(9)NO (4-EBM)] have been synthesized. The ligands have been verified via various spectroscopic methods such as IR, NMR, etc. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction methods were applied to identify the structure of 4-EBP. Absorption/emission spectroscopic titration was used to assess the interaction of ligands to calf thymus (CT) DNA. DNA binding studies revealed interactions characterized by hyperchromicity and a slight redshift. 4-EBP showed the highest binding constant (1.58 x 10(5)), indicating that it binds stronger to CT-DNA. The red shift and significant hypochromic shift seen in the fluorescence titration spectra of the BSA binding probes showed the strong interaction of the ligand to BSA. EGFR protein docking investigations verified the potential of the ligands to treat its targets. 4-EBP has the highest docking score (-6.7987 kcal) compared to other synthesized ligands. The B3LYP/6-311 G (d, p) ++ was implemented to calculate density functional theory (DFT). All ligands have a LogP value below 5, indicating lipophilic properties suitable for SwissADME studies. All new ligands follow Lipinski's drug class rules. Low synthetic input levels between 2 and 3 indicate the best results for this material. Each ligand (2-EBP to 4-EBM) has been marked to perform as an oral drug candidate. To test the anticancer potential of four ligands (2-EBP to 4-EBM). 4-EBP showed good efficacy against endothelial and liver cancer cells, with IC(50) values of 21.2 +/- 0.1 and 45.3 +/- 0.1 against MCF-7 and HepG-2 respectively.
abstract_zh: R(2) - C(S) - NH - N = CH - R(1) [R(1) = o-OCH(2)CH(3) 且 R(2) = C(4)H(9)N (2-EBP)，R(1) = o-OCH(2)CH(3) 且 R(2) = C(4)H(9)NO (2-EBM)，R(1) = p-OCH(2)CH(3) 且 R(2) = C(4)H(9)N (4-EBP)，以及 R(1) = p-OCH(2)CH(3) 且 R(2) = C(4)H(9)NO (4-EBM)] 已被合成。这些配体已通过多种光谱方法（如红外光谱 (IR)、核磁共振 (NMR) 等）进行验证。采用单晶X射线衍射方法确定了4-EBP的结构。使用吸收/发射光谱滴定法评估配体与小牛胸腺 (CT) DNA 的相互作用。DNA结合研究表明，相互作用表现为增色效应和轻微红移。4-EBP显示出最高的结合常数（1.58 x 10(5)），表明其与CT-DNA结合更强。在牛血清白蛋白 (BSA) 结合探针的荧光滴定光谱中观察到的红移和显著减色位移，显示了配体与BSA的强相互作用。EGFR蛋白对接研究验证了配体治疗其靶标的潜力。与其他合成配体相比，4-EBP具有最高的对接得分（-6.7987 kcal）。采用B3LYP/6-311 G (d, p) ++方法计算密度泛函理论 (DFT)。所有配体的LogP值均低于5，表明其亲脂性适合SwissADME研究。所有新配体均遵循Lipinski药物类规则。2至3之间的低合成输入水平表明该材料的最佳结果。每个配体（2-EBP至4-EBM）均被标记为可作为口服药物候选物。为测试四种配体（2-EBP至4-EBM）的抗癌潜力，4-EBP对内皮细胞和肝癌细胞显示出良好疗效，对MCF-7和HepG-2的IC(50)值分别为21.2 ± 0.1和45.3 ± 0.1。
